an4.53:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā antarā ca Madhuraṃ antarā ca Verañjim addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti,
an4.53:1.2: sambahulā ca kho gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca antarā Verañjiṃ antarā ca Madhuraṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.
an4.53:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an4.53:1.4: Addasaṃsu kho gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca Bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ
an4.53:1.5: disvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca Bhagavā etad avoca :-- 2.
an4.53:3.1: Kathañ ca gahapatayo chavo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati?
an4.53:3.2: Idha gahapatayo sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesu micchācārī musāvādī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī dussīlo pāpadhammo maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ,
an4.53:3.3: bhariyā pi 'ssa hoti pāṇātipātinī adinnādāyinī kāmesu micchācārinī musāvādinī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyinī dussīlā pāpadhammā maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.53:3.4: Evaṃ kho gahapatayo chavo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati. 4.
an4.53:4.1: Kathañ ca gahapatayo chavo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati?
an4.53:4.2: Idha gahapatayo sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātī . . . pe . . . akkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ,
an4.53:4.3: bhariyā ca khvassa hoti pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesu micchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati anakkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.53:4.4: Evaṃ kho gahapatayo chavo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati. 5.
an4.53:5.1: Kathañ ca gahapatayo devo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati?
an4.53:5.2: Idha gahapatayo sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātā paṭivirato adinnādānā pativirato kāmesu micchācārā pativirato musāvādā paṭivirato surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati anakkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.53:5.3: bhariyā ca khvassa hoti pānātipātinī . . . pe . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyinī dussīlā pāpadhammā maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.53:5.4: Evaṃ kho gahapatayo devo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati. 6.
an4.53:6.1: Kathañ ca gahapatayo devo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati?
an4.53:6.2: Idha gahapatayo sāmiko hoti pānātipātā paṭivirato . . . pe . . . anakkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ,
an4.53:6.3: bhariyāpi 'ssa hoti pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā . . . anakkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.53:6.4: Evaṃ kho gahapatayo devo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
an4.53:6.5: Ime kho gahapatayo cattāro saṃvāsā ti. 7.
